text: The DONE cutoff is project-level CANON on disk -- `intent/.canon/project.json` -- so it crosses a git clone: a machine that has never run a command in the project renders the same cutoff, and does not resurrect every completed thread into DONE. NOT `intent/.config/config.json`, which holds choices a person makes and would give one file two writers; NOT the thread canon, because the cutoff is project-level and belongs to no thread. (hv, 2026-08-26: the cutoff is canon state.)
